mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payments (id, user_id, related_id, amount, type, method, status, order_no, qr_code_url, transaction_id, operator_id, remark, create_time, update_time, delete_flag) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{relatedId}, #{amount}, #{type}, #{method}, #{status}, #{orderNo}, #{qrCodeUrl}, #{transactionId}, #{operatorId}, #{remark}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{deleted})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM payments WHERE id = #{id} AND delete_flag = 0
SELECT * FROM payments WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND delete_flag = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE payments SET status = #{status}, transaction_id = #{transactionId}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND delete_flag = 0
mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.user_id, u.name as user_name, p.related_id, p.amount, p.type, p.method, p.status, p.create_time, op.name as operator_name, -- 关联业务信息（需要根据具体业务表查询） NULL as related_type, NULL as related_title, NULL as related_time FROM payments p LEFT JOIN user u ON p.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN user op ON p.operator_id = op.id WHERE p.id = #{id} AND p.delete_flag = 0
SELECT * FROM payments WHERE status = 'pending' AND delete_flag = 0 AND create_time <= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{timeoutMinutes} MINUTE) ORDER BY create_time ASC
